original.target_description: Study 1: main effect of same-culture, other-culture, and extraterrestrial condition on moral objectivist/relativist agreement ratings across two transgressions in the mixed-model ANOVA.

n.sample_role: Participants in the Study 1 critical mixed-model ANOVA; analytic count not explicitly reported.
n.exclusions: No exclusions or final condition counts reported in Study 1; 223 is the questionnaire-completer count, not an explicitly identified analytic N.
n.location: Study 1, Participants, printed p. 487 (PDF p. 6); Results, printed p. 488 (PDF p. 7)
n.quote:
223 students (112 females) taking introductory philosophy courses at Baruch College
voluntarily completed a questionnaire after class. ... The data were analyzed using a mixed-model ANOVA, with condition as a
between-participants factor and transgression as a within-subject factor. ... significant main effect of condition, F (2, 218) = 20.7, p < .001, η2 = .16.

replication.target_description: Unassigned side; not assessed in this source-grouped completion.

notes: Only n_o was assigned. Other fields and replication are unassigned placeholders. Study 1 and the condition main effect match the description and PDF p. 7 locator. The source reports 223 questionnaire completers, but does not explicitly give the critical-model analytic N or mutually exclusive final group counts. Do not substitute the completer count or derive N from F degrees of freedom. No arithmetic performed. Rendered PDF pp. 6–7 inspected. Printed same-test statistics retained here as context only: F (2, 218) = 20.7, p < .001, η2 = .16.
